Broadcast Audio Scan Server Exported Functions

bool bass_cfg_pa_sync_param(uint8_t source_id, uint8_t pa_sync_options, uint16_t pa_sync_skip, uint16_t pa_sync_timeout_10ms, uint16_t past_timeout_10ms)

BASS set PA sync parameters.

bass_mgr.h

This API is used when receive LE_AUDIO_MSG_BASS_GET_PA_SYNC_PARAM.

参数:

  • source_id -- [in] Source id.

  • pa_sync_options -- [in] PA create sync options.

  • pa_sync_skip -- [in] The maximum number of periodic advertising events that can be skipped after a is successful receive.

    • Range: 0x0000 to 0x01F3.

  • pa_sync_timeout_10ms -- [in] PA sync timeout.

    • Range: 0x000A to 0x4000.

    • Time = N*10 ms.

    • Time Range: 100 ms to 163.84 s.

  • past_timeout_10ms -- [in] PAST timeout.

返回值:

  • true -- Set PA sync parameters is successful.

  • false -- Set PA sync parameters failed.

返回:

The result of set PA sync parameters.
